title: Merchant status and the particular UCC provision
shortTitle: Merchant status and the particular UCC provision
summary: Merchant status depends on the goods or business practices relevant to the provision being applied.
notes: The firm-offer notes distinguish expertise in goods from expertise in business practices. Section 2-207’s special incorporation rule applies between merchants; a nonmerchant’s receipt of an added term instead raises a proposal-and-assent question. A business buying equipment for its own use is not classified solely by whether it resells that product. Hill also warns that later commercial use of retail software does not by itself establish software-merchant status.
